messages:
melisa: Heads-up — prepping the 22:00 UTC release window. Cross-service check: runtime v1.14.0, api v2.7.1, console v1.3.0, router v0.12.4. Any known incompatibilities?
andre: Runtime change: KV eviction semantics tightened (LRU -> TTL bias). Should be ok but API has a short-lived cache header we rely on. Need to confirm router preserves x-cache-ttl.
samir: Observability note: the runtime patch also enables a different batching path that can bump p95 for short requests. We saw ~30ms increase in local perf tests for 32B seq.
zoe: Router preserves headers by default, but our current release patch for 0.12.4 drops unknown headers in the streaming probe for older configs. We can flip keep_unknown_headers=true in router config.
melisa: Can we do that as a hotfix before canary? small config change preferred to rolling back versions.
andre: Yes, quick toggle. But need to coordinate pinning for api + runtime during canary gating. If anything spikes, we want an easy rollback path.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot has started canary: api/v2.7.1 -> 5% traffic, runtime/v1.14.0 applied to canary pool (pool:canary-2). Logs: deploy-1728456789-01
samir: Canary metrics coming in — tail latency up ~28ms p95 for generate endpoint on canary nodes. Error rate stable.
zoe: Routing tweak ready. Command we will run:
```
routerctl set-config --cluster canary-2 --keep_unknown_headers true
routerctl route set-weight --service api --version v2.7.0 --weight 95
```
melisa: Hold on additional rollout until after toggle. If latency doesn't recover within 15m we rollback api to v2.7.0 for canary and pin routing.
release-coordinator: Noted — updating release notes draft: add "runtime v1.14.0: KV eviction semantics changed (config KEY_EVICT_TTL), may increase p95 for small payloads — router config keep_unknown_headers recommended."
samir: After toggle: p95 dropped ~10ms but still +18ms vs baseline. Given customers with tight SLOs, propose we rollback api canary and defer runtime rollout to a patch.
andre: Agreed. We're ready with rollback script.
```
# rollback snippet
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/api --to-revision=rs/api-v2.7.0
deploy-bot rollback --service api --from-version v2.7.1 --to-version v2.7.0 --target canary-2
```
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for api canary -> reverting to v2.7.0 on pool:canary-2. Rollback job: rollback-1728456789-01
zoe: Router weight adjusted back to 100% v2.7.0 for safety.
melisa: OK — runtime rollout paused. We'll open a follow-up postmortem item to tune batching heuristics and decide whether to iterate runtime patch or change default router behavior.
release-coordinator: Scheduling a 1hr follow-up meeting tomorrow 09:30 UTC to triage. I'll attach the canary traces and the draft notes.
melisa: Thanks everyone. Good call on the toggle + quick rollback. :thumbsup:
andre: +1
samir: Thanks — logs saved under /releases/1728456789/canary-traces
deploy-bot: Deployment thread closed (status: rolled back).
